user.title: Läutwerk
user.description: Set up Läutwerk? Rules are created afterwards in the Läutwerk card on a dashboard.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Marks reminders as done. With 'rule': the open reminders of that rule (or its next planned reminder if the first reminder time is less than 24 h away). Without 'rule': all open reminders of all rules. Returns the acknowledged reminder ids when response data is requested.

rule.name: Rule
rule.description: Rule id (see get_rules). Empty: all open reminders.

reminder_id.name: Reminder
reminder_id.description: Acknowledge exactly this reminder (id from get_rules → status.reminders).

person.name: Person
person.description: Name stored as 'acknowledged by'. Default: the person of the calling user.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Reminds again later: open reminders become planned again and remind once more when the duration is over (unless they expire first). Without 'rule': all open reminders.

rule.name: Rule
rule.description: Rule id. Empty: all open reminders.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes, or a duration such as 30m, 3h, 1d.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Reminds now: sends the immediate signals of the rule for its open or next planned reminder, regardless of the reminder times.

test_signal.name: Test signal
test_signal.description: Sends one signal of a rule right now, ignoring its conditions, quiet times and limits. Uses the open reminder, else the next matching event, else a sample event for tomorrow. Give either 'signal' (id of a saved signal) or 'config' (a signal object that is not saved, requires admin).

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: Id of a signal of the rule.

config.name: Signal object
config.description: Unsaved signal to try out (same fields as a signal in create_rule).

get_rules.name: Get rules
get_rules.description: Returns the rules (configuration as used by create_rule/update_rule) with their runtime status: state (planned/reminded/done/missed/inactive), reminders with variables, next matching event, calendar errors.

rule.name: Rule
rule.description: One or more rule ids. Empty: all rules.

create_rule.name: Create rule
create_rule.description: Creates a rule and returns its id. Requires admin.

config.name: Rule
config.description: Rule object. Required: name, sources (calendar entity ids), reminders (list of objects with 'at'). Optional: id, icon, color, enabled, filter (all_day, keywords with columns = list of variable names and rows = list of objects with match, mode contains/startswith/regex and one value per column), signals (list). Every signal: id, type, enabled, when ('now' = at the reminder time, or an object with opportunity = Home Assistant trigger(s) as in automations and manual_only = only real operation, not automations; an opportunity signal fires whenever the trigger fires while the reminder is open), conditions (Home Assistant conditions, 'only if') with conditions_match all/any, limit (per_reminder = maximum sends per reminder, min_interval = minutes between sends), quiet (list of objects with from, to as HH:MM and mode skip or defer = send when the quiet time ends). type notify: targets = list of notify.xxx actions and/or audience all/present/persons (with persons = list of person entities; uses their mobile app devices), title, title_plural, message, message_plural, actions = push buttons, list of objects with label and either ack: true or snooze: duration such as 3h, data. type light_signal: entities = light entities, pattern (effect blink/pulse, count, interval in seconds), color (name, #hex or r,g,b) or color_from = keyword column holding the colour, brightness in percent, restore (bring the light back to its previous state, default true). type announce: players = media players, text, text_plural, volume 0-100, tts = TTS entity, language, voice. type action: actions = any Home Assistant action sequence; the text variables are available as template variables. acknowledge (further ways to acknowledge, list of objects: type tag with tag_id = NFC tag; type trigger with trigger = Home Assistant trigger such as a door contact, zone or button, and early = also before the reminder time), repeat ('none' or an object with every = minutes or a duration such as 1h, and max = number of repetitions), ack_label, bundle (events of the same day become one reminder, default true), expire (default event_end). Times: '-1d 17:00' (day before at 17:00), '09:00' (event day), '-2h' (before the start), 'event_day 12:00', 'event_end'. Text variables, written in curly braces in the texts: titel, rest, beschreibung, ort, kalender, wann, datum, uhrzeit, one per keyword column and its plural with an appended n (e.g. tonne / tonnen).

update_rule.name: Update rule
update_rule.description: Changes a rule: the given top-level keys replace the stored ones (e.g. only 'signals' or 'reminders'); open reminders are kept. Requires admin.

delete_rule.name: Delete rule
delete_rule.description: Deletes a rule with its reminders and entities. Requires admin.

duplicate_rule.name: Duplicate rule
duplicate_rule.description: Copies a rule; the copy is switched off. Returns the new id. Requires admin.

new_rule.name: New id
new_rule.description: Id of the copy (default: derived from the name).

rule.name: Rule
rule.description: One or more rule ids. Empty: all rules.

disable.name: Disable
disable.description: Switches rules off; their open reminders are dropped.

rule.name: Rule
rule.description: One or more rule ids. Empty: all rules.

no_upcoming_event.message: Rule {rule} has no upcoming event to remind of.

signal_failed.message: The signal could not be sent – see the log for details.

missing_entities.title: Läutwerk rule "{rule}" refers to missing entities
missing_entities.description:
The rule "{rule}" uses entities or actions that do not exist (any more): {entities}.

Calendars that are missing are not read, signals to missing lights, speakers or phones are not sent. Restore them or edit the rule in the Läutwerk card. This message disappears as soon as everything is available again.
